# Fey DS

> Fey-inspired financial research UI design system and composed Markets demo.

## Canonical pages

- Markets demo: https://amtsh.github.io/fey-ds/
- Design system gallery: https://amtsh.github.io/fey-ds/design-system/
- Source repository: https://github.com/amtsh/fey-ds

## Machine-readable resources

- Component manifest: https://amtsh.github.io/fey-ds/design-system/components.json
- Design tokens: https://amtsh.github.io/fey-ds/design-system/tokens.json

## Important context

- This is an independent Fey-inspired recreation, not affiliated with Fey or Wealthsimple.
- Calibre is not bundled; the site uses the system font stack and will use SF Pro on Apple platforms.
- Cards use surface tint rather than generic shadows or hard borders.
- Hairlines are reserved for tables, tabs, and structural separators.
- Green and red communicate financial performance only.

## Components

PillButton, IconButton, Kbd, TickerBadge, Delta, TextInput, TextArea, Checkbox, Toggle, Radio, Select, Chip, Alert, Spinner, Progress, Skeleton, Tabs, Toast, EmptyState, Pagination, Breadcrumb, Slider, MenuRow, Modal, SearchField, SegmentedControl, NavItem, SurfaceCard, NewsCard, InsiderRow, Sparkline, WatchlistRow, TickerHero, DataTable, EarningsChip, CommandPalette, StatTile, StatusDot.

## Usage

Use the JSON resources for exact token and component metadata. Prefer stable fragment IDs in the design-system gallery for human inspection.
